title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (September, 2026)
summary: Monthly roundup of Business Central cumulative updates for September 2026: BC29 is in public preview, BC28 CU05 (28.5), BC27 CU11 (27.11) and BC26 CU17 (26.17) are released with their build numbers, and BC25 back to BC13 are end of life. It also lists lifecycle dates for on-premises Modern and Fixed policy versions.
key_points: BC28 CU05 is version 28.5 with platform 28.0.54016.0 and application 28.5.54151.54178 for cloud and on-premises
BC27 CU11 is 27.11 and BC26 CU17 is 26.17, each with its application and platform builds
BC29 (2026 release wave 2) is available in public preview
BC25 and all older versions down to BC13 are marked end of life
Under the Modern Lifecycle Policy, version 28.x is supported until Oct 13, 2027 and 26.x until Oct 13, 2026

quotes.text: The public preview for Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29) is available
quotes.why_it_matters: Announces the availability of the next major version for partners and customers to test new features early

quotes.text: Dynamics 365 Business Central on-premises (Modern Policy) follows the Modern Lifecycle Policy
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the support timeline and policy framework for on-premises deployments using the Modern Lifecycle Policy
